Multi-Color Slimline Jewel Cases
40-Pack, 5mm Thickness
The Maxell CD-366 slimline jewel case pack provides space-saving, durable housing for compact discs, DVDs, and CD-ROM media. Engineered at 5mm thick, each case occupies half the shelf space of a traditional jewel case, enabling double the media storage capacity within standard shelving and storage units. The vibrant multi-color translucent trays offer convenient color-coded organization for audio collections, software backups, and digital media archives.
Includes 40 slimline jewel cases formatted for standard 120mm CD, CD-R, CD-ROM, and DVD media
Translucent multi-color trays enable quick visual sorting and color-coded organization
Compact 5mm thickness allows two slimline cases to occupy the space of one standard jewel case

283083141.description:
Cross
Classic Century Ballpoint Pen and Mechanical Pencil Set
1/20 12KT Gold Filled, Vintage with Original Box
The Cross Classic Century collection is a hallmark of American industrial design, celebrated for its slender silhouette and iconic conical top. Introduced to commemorate the company's centennial, this 12-karat gold-filled set represents the pinnacle of mid-20th-century professional writing instruments, combining a refined aesthetic with durable mechanical reliability.
1/20 12KT Gold Filled finish with linear pinstripe engraving on barrels
Twist-action mechanisms for ballpoint ink and mechanical lead advancement
Personalized engraving "DAVID #1" on upper barrel of both instruments
Complete with original presentation box and operating instructions booklet
Condition:
Good vintage condition. Both pieces are personalized with "DAVID #1" near the clip. Gold-filled surfaces show light micro-scratching and minor age-appropriate patina. Mechanical components function smoothly as intended. The original presentation case is intact with minor external shelf wear and a clean green velvet-style interior.

Natural Mineral & Crystal Specimen Lot
Mixed Geological Rocks and Crystals
5-Piece Collection
A diverse 5-piece collection of natural mineral specimens and crystal formations, ideal for display, study, or rockhound collections. This selection exhibits varied geological formations, including geode cavities, macrocrystalline quartz, banded agate, and cleavage-rich feldspar.
Items Included:
Purple amethyst crystal cluster on natural rock matrix
Polished blue dyed agate nodule section with hollow center druzy pocket
Natural quartz crystal geode half with concave crystalline cavity
Rough milky quartz crystal cluster showing distinct crystal terminations
Salmon pink feldspar mineral specimen with visible cleavage planes
Condition:
Natural geological specimens showing authentic raw textures, crystalline facets, and matrix inclusions. The polished agate slice features a smooth face and intact druzy center. Clusters and geode cavities show natural formation edges and light surface dust.
